Redacted PDF – Privacy Tool

A privacy-focused PDF redaction tool that allows users to securely remove sensitive information from PDF documents. Built with a focus on data privacy — all processing happens client-side, ensuring no data is ever uploaded to a server. This tool is especially relevant for businesses in Germany that need GDPR-compliant document handling.

Key responsibilities

  • Built client-side PDF processing engine for maximum privacy
  • Implemented text selection and redaction overlay system
  • Ensured zero data leaves the browser (GDPR compliant)
  • Designed an intuitive UI for non-technical users

Tech stack

JavaScript PDF.js HTML/CSS Client-side Processing Netlify
